title: QuizPlugin
description: Daily Quiz & Quiz Tower plugin with 100 floors, rankings, and EmeraldBank integration
body:
# QuizPlugin - Daily Quiz & Quiz Tower

A comprehensive quiz plugin featuring daily quizzes and a challenging 100-floor Quiz Tower with EmeraldBank economy integration.

## Features

### Daily Quiz
- **5 Questions Daily** - Answer 5 random questions each day
- **Streak Bonuses** - Earn extra rewards for consecutive participation (3, 7, 14, 30 days)
- **Emerald Rewards** - 5E per correct answer + 25E perfect bonus
- **Daily Reset** - Configurable reset time

### Quiz Tower
- **100 Floors** - Climb the tower by answering questions correctly
- **Entry Fee** - 100 emeralds to challenge
- **10 Lives** - Game over after 10 wrong answers
- **Progressive Difficulty** - Easy (1-30F), Medium (31-60F), Hard (61-90F), Expert (91-100F)
- **Checkpoint Rewards** - Rewards every 10 floors
- **Retreat System** - Leave anytime with partial rewards

### Rankings
- **Accuracy Ranking** - Compare correct answer rates
- **Total Correct Ranking** - Total number of correct answers
- **Tower Ranking** - Highest floor reached (clear time for completers)
- **Monthly Reset** - Configurable ranking reset

### Additional Features
- **100 Questions Included** - Pre-loaded Minecraft-themed questions
- **GUI Interface** - User-friendly inventory-based quiz interface
- **Citizens NPC Support** - Optional NPC integration for quiz access
- **Ranking Signs** - Display rankings on signs
- **Anti-Cheat** - Prevents rapid answering and duplicate questions

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/quiz daily` `/qd` | Start daily quiz | `quiz.daily` |
| `/quiz tower` `/qt` | Challenge Quiz Tower | `quiz.tower` |
| `/quiz ranking [type]` | View rankings | `quiz.ranking` |
| `/quiz admin reload` | Reload config | `quiz.admin.reload` |
| `/quiznpc` | Manage NPCs | `quiz.admin.npc` |
| `/quizsign` | Manage ranking signs | `quiz.admin.sign` |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `quiz.use` | Use quiz features | false |
| `quiz.daily` | Access daily quiz | false |
| `quiz.tower` | Access quiz tower | false |
| `quiz.ranking` | View rankings | false |
| `quiz.admin` | Admin commands | false |

## Dependencies

| Plugin | Required |
|--------|----------|
| EmeraldBank | Yes |
| Citizens | No (for NPC support) |

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

デイリークイズ＆クイズタワープラグインです。

**デイリークイズ:** 毎日5問のクイズに挑戦。1問正解で5E、全問正解で追加25E。3/7/14/30日連続参加ボーナスあり。

**クイズタワー:** 100階建てのタワーに挑戦！参加費100E、10回失敗でゲームオーバー。階が上がるごとに難易度アップ。10階ごとにチェックポイント報酬。

**ランキング:** 正解率・総正解数・タワー到達階の3種類。

100問の問題を同梱、GUI操作、Citizens NPCとランキング看板にも対応。
